products.name: Phrase (Memsource)
products.note: Enterprise localization AI; TMS; machine translation; EU-hosted; GDPR

profile_text.body:
Phrase is an enterprise software company that describes itself as an AI-powered language intelligence platform for localization and translation. Its platform is designed to automate multilingual content workflows at scale, connecting to a wide range of AI engines and large language models, including those a customer brings themselves, and routing each content asset to the appropriate model based on content type, quality requirements, and cost. The site describes features including intelligent orchestration, translation memory, terminology management, style guides, quality estimation, budget controls, and advanced analytics, all built on a headless, API-first architecture that supports both human-to-system and agent-to-agent interaction. The company also describes a Verified Solutions Programme, native integrations, MCP server connectivity, and a Forward Deployed Engineers service that works directly in customer environments.

The held facts identify Phrase, also tracked under the name Phrase (Memsource), as an enterprise localization product in the search, research, translation, and other category. It is noted as offering a translation management system and machine translation with EU hosting and GDPR compliance. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
